status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Inlined into server.mjs by esbuild because neither is published: the engine is an unpublished candidate, and the comparison is TypeScript in the site repository. Bundling is what keeps one copy of the comparison rules rather than two.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard.

changedSince: rc.1 through rc.14 remain unchanged as separate archives. This candidate bundles engine 0.1.1-rc.15 in place of rc.14. Its three tools and their arguments are rc.14's; its answers change where the engine's do. From 1972 to 2027-10-02 the engine reads an instant as UTC, with TT from the IERS leap seconds and UT1 from IERS UT1 - UTC, where rc.14 read it as UT1 with its Delta T model, so in those years the sidereal time moves by UT1 - UTC: in the site's comparison the midheaven by up to 12.7 arcseconds and the ascendant by up to 62.7 (at 69.6 degrees north; more nearer the poles), and the bodies by up to 0.5 arcseconds (the Moon). In other years only the true nodes move, by under 0.1 arcseconds (docs/platform/evidence/site-engine-rc15/ in the site repository). The records it writes use the engine's time-basis conventions set and carry the time basis (receipt.timeScale and result.timeScale); records of the rc.8 set, which rc.8 to rc.14 wrote, are still read. The comparison reports a record's time scale among its inputs and its time basis beside Delta T, and replays a record on its own scale. This adapter still takes an instant in UTC or with an explicit offset and resolves no time zones, so the engine's new local-time history before 1970 does not reach it, and it exposes none of the engine's timing or Vedic functions, nor chartPoints. The engine's Node requirement, 20.19.0 or a later 20.x, or 22.7.0 or later, is for importing the package unbundled; server.mjs carries the engine bundled, and this adapter still requires Node 22 or later. A record naming another engine version is not reproduced on this engine; its differences remain hypotheses.
